description_en: Bind a Resource Access Management (RAM) user to a standard database account in a cluster
description_zh: 绑定RAM用户与集群的数据库普通账号
kebab_example: aliyun adb bind-account --db-cluster-id amv-wz99d9nh5320000 --account-name test_accout --api-version 2021-12-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: BindAccount

parameters.help_en: ID of the cluster. Applies to Enterprise Edition, Basic Edition, or Data Lakehouse Edition clusters
parameters.help_zh:
<props="china">企业版、基础版或湖仓版的集群ID。</props>
<props="intl">湖仓版集群ID。</props>
parameters.name: db_cluster_id

parameters.help_en: ID of the Alibaba Cloud RAM user to bind
parameters.help_zh: 绑定的阿里云 RAM 用户 ID
parameters.name: ram_user

parameters.help_en: List of Alibaba Cloud RAM user IDs to bind. You can bind only one RAM user at a time. If you specify this parameter, the RamUser parameter is ignored
parameters.help_zh: 绑定的阿里云 RAM 用户 ID 列表，当前仅支持绑定一个，指定该参数时RamUser参数不生效
parameters.name: ram_user_list
